description: Read-only CLI for searching and extracting public Naver Blog (네이버 블로그) posts — engagement metrics that match the live page exactly, no Playwright required.

required_headers.name: User-Agent
required_headers.value: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_4 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/17.4 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1

tools.name: blogs_feed
tools.description: List recent posts from a Naver blog with engagement metrics already populated. Pagination via --page; items array is empty when no more pages. Required: blog_id. Optional: category (default: 0), limit (default: 30), page (default: 1). Returns array of FeedPost.

params.name: category
params.description: Category ID filter (0 = all categories; positive int = specific category)

params.name: limit
params.description: Max posts per page (Naver caps at ~30)

tools.name: find_hashtag
tools.description: Search Naver Blog posts by hashtag(s). Use 'tag1,tag2' for multiple; --require-all returns only posts containing all tags. Required: tags. Optional: where (default: m_view), require-all (default: false), month (plus 1 more).

params.name: tags
params.description: Comma-separated hashtag(s) without '#'; the CLI adds '#' to each before query

params.name: require-all
params.description: When set, return only posts that match every tag (intersect results)

tools.name: find_posts
tools.description: Find Naver Blog posts by keyword (live Naver search). Returns mobile blog URLs, title, and snippet. Pair with --agent --select to narrow the output for AI consumers. Required: query. Optional: where (default: m_view), month, limit (default: 22).

params.name: where
params.description: Naver search vertical (default 'm_view' = mobile integrated view; do not change unless you know the Naver internal vertical codes)

params.name: query
params.description: Search query (Korean preferred; UTF-8). URL-encoded automatically.

params.name: month
params.description: Optional YYYY-MM filter to bound results by upload month (applied client-side)

params.name: limit
params.description: Max results to return (1-22; one SERP page)

tools.name: posts_get
tools.description: Get a single Naver Blog post by blog ID and log number. Extracts title, body, tags from the mobile post page, then queries the reaction API for the like count and PostView.naver for comment count. Output matches what you see in a browser. Required: blog_id, log_no. Returns the Post.

params.name: blog_id
params.description: Blog ID (the part after the slash in blog.naver.com/<this>/123456789)

params.name: log_no
params.description: Log/post number (12+ digit integer at the end of the post URL)

tools.name: reactions_get
tools.description: Get like/공감 counts for one or more posts. The 'q' parameter is composed as BLOG[blog_id_log_no,blog_id_log_no,...] — the post command builds this automatically; use directly only for batch queries. Required: q. Optional: pool (default: blogid), dedupe (default: false). Returns the ReactionBatch.

params.name: dedupe
params.description: Naver internal: deduplicate contents (false in production)
